title: The Branch & the shelter
introduction: Preparation guide for Thursday 17 September. The pastors’ teaching for Isaiah 4 is still being prepared. These reading prompts are a temporary study aid and will be replaced with the class notes.
finalWord: Pastoral teaching is forthcoming. For now, read the passage, note what you observe, and bring your questions to Thursday’s gathering.

points.title: Read the chapter in context
points.text: Read Isaiah 4 in full using the WEB reader. Then return to the closing verses of chapter 3. Notice how the consequences of judgment lead into the hope announced in chapter 4. Write down the change you observe in tone and imagery.

points.title: Notice the promise and the cleansing
points.text: Identify the words describing the branch, those who remain, and the cleansing of Zion. Which actions belong to God? Bring one observation and one question to the gathering.

points.title: Reflect on the shelter
points.text: Observe the cloud, fire, covering, and shelter. Use the cross references to explore connections with God’s care for his people. Consider what these images suggest about dependence on him.
